Clack Bands

Clack bands are round press-paper bands fitted during winding and assembly of power transformers. Ours are light, easy to fit and finished without rough edges, so they do not damage conductor insulation.

Indicative price: On request (excluding GST; final price on quotation)

Specifications

MaterialPress paper / pressboard
ShapeRound

FinishSmooth, light in weight
Transformer typePower transformers

Where it is used

  • Binding and holding winding sections during assembly
  • Supporting leads and crossovers
  • Protective banding around winding ends

Common questions

What is a clack band?

A round band of press paper fitted around winding sections to hold them in place during assembly and to support leads.
